narrative.intro: Mistral's federal contract profile in FY2026 to date shows a concentrated, rapid increase in obligations. Total obligations are $213M. AwardCount is 9 and average award size is $23.7M. Obligations are up 384.3% year over year. Fiscal-year history shows small activity in earlier years before FY25 and a jump in FY25 to $44M followed by the current FY26 total of $213M. The Department of Defense is the dominant buyer with $213M in obligations. Other markets with recorded obligations include Other Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing at $191M and Aircraft Manufacturing at $22.5M. Smaller NAICS categories with activity include Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment Repair and Maintenance at $15.1K and Irradiation Apparatus Manufacturing at $7.4K. The note on figures clarifies that these are contract obligations except where tables list award-value figures as total contract values. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity.

sections.heading: Why did obligations change so much year over year?
sections.body: Mistral's obligations rose sharply because FY25 recorded $44M and FY26 recorded $213M after several prior years of much smaller activity. Fiscal years with smaller obligations include FY21 at $224K, FY22 at $39.4K, and FY24 at $727K. The year over year figure shows obligations are up 384.3%.

sections.heading: Where and to whom is Mistral selling?
sections.body: The Department of Defense is the primary buyer with $213M in obligations. The Department of Justice recorded obligations of $7.4K. Major product markets include Other Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing at $191M and Aircraft Manufacturing at $22.5M, with smaller amounts in Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment Repair and Maintenance at $15.1K and Irradiation Apparatus Manufacturing at $7.4K.

faq.q: How much does Mistral make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Mistral's total federal contract obligations are $213M. AwardCount is 9 and average award size is $23.7M. The company recorded $44M in FY25 and $213M so far in FY26. Obligations are up 384.3% year over year.
The Department of Defense buys from Mistral with obligations of $213M. The Department of Justice also recorded obligations of $7.4K.

faq.q: What does Mistral sell to the government?
faq.a: Mistral sells products in guided missile and space vehicle parts and auxiliary equipment, with obligations of $191M, and in aircraft manufacturing with obligations of $22.5M. Mistral also has recorded activity in Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment Repair and Maintenance at $15.1K and Irradiation Apparatus Manufacturing at $7.4K.
